clusters.name: probe-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Touches only the external probe repo plus a decision artifact; fully disjoint from codex source. It is the GO/NO-GO gate for every other cluster, so nothing else may start until it returns GO.

clusters.name: routing-skeleton
clusters.executionModeRationale: Adds the enum/route/gate seams plus a degrade-to-chat dispatch stub; compiles independently and is inert (always degrades to the working unsigned path). Must land first and alone because its chat_transport.rs/client.rs/patch-surface.md edits overlap the dispatch-join cluster.

clusters.name: inbound-capture
clusters.executionModeRationale: Surfaces the thinking/signature deltas and persists the signature into encrypted_content; serialized after routing-skeleton because both edit core/src/chat_transport.rs and the patch-surface ledger. File-disjoint from outbound-builder, so the two may run in parallel if a coordinator manages the shared patch-surface.md prepend.

clusters.name: outbound-builder
clusters.executionModeRationale: A new overlay file (zero upstream conflict surface) consuming only the frozen encrypted_content slot; file-disjoint from inbound-capture, so it can run in parallel with it. It does not touch routing, so it only needs the probe GO.

clusters.name: dispatch-join
clusters.executionModeRationale: Replaces the dispatch stub with the real WireApi::AnthropicMessages arm plus the stream_anthropic_messages driver and adds the round-trip integration test; depends on all three Phase-2/3 clusters and re-touches the shared core files, so it serializes last among the build clusters.

clusters.name: harden-verify
clusters.executionModeRationale: Network-audit allowlist plus consolidated section 15 replant note plus full local cargo gates plus dogfood smoke; runs after the join is complete so the audit reflects the final egress surface.
